en: Vintage sepia panoramic view over a small European town with dense tiled-roof houses and gardens in the foreground. A large neo-Gothic church with a tall central spire and two smaller flanking spires dominates the right side. At the top left, the word "Apolda." is printed, and on the right edge there is a vertical publisher credit. The overall look suggests an early 20th‑century printed postcard.
